facts.value: This page is for individuals from/residing in EU/EFTA/UK countries who wish to undertake a full degree at University of Limerick.
EU applicants are considered in competition with Irish school leavers.
Consequently, offers cannot be issued until Round 1 offers after the Irish Leaving Certificate results are released.
Eligible applicants remain on the waiting list and may be offered in order of merit in later rounds, in accordance with CAO procedures.
We do not issue conditional offers.
The definition of EU/Non-EU applicants is based on fee assessment criteria.
If you are unsure whether you are an EU or non-EU applicant, please visit the fee classification page.
Generally, if you are eligible for EU fees and applying for the first year of an undergraduate degree, you must apply via the Central Applications Office (CAO).
The CAO handbook gives details of application procedures and closing dates.
Applicants not eligible for EU fees and transfer applicants (post year 1) must apply directly to the University.
Detailed information regarding the recognised qualifications from each EU/EFTA/UK country can be found on the CAO website.

This document outlines the recognition of the school leaving examinations for each EU/EFTA/UK country and includes details on the recognition of multi-national qualifications, such as the European Baccalaureate and the International Baccalaureate.
